notes: The supplied text (pages 356-357) is the Radiologic Technology Certificate of Achievement section (running header 'Radiologic Technology (Certificate of Achievement)', certificate residence/scholarship rules), followed by the Residential Elect. Apprentice certificate. No A.S. Degree section appears, so no blocks, totals or outcomes were recorded for the A.S. award.

The certificate section prints prerequisites (CS 5, HLC 160, RADT 100, ENGL C1000 or EMLS 10, ANAT 1 or 58, PHYZ 1 or 58, and three 3-unit choice lists), a 'Radiologic Technology Requirements - complete 70.00 units' block (RADT 60, 61A, 61B, 61C, 63A, 63B, 64, 64L, 65, 66, 68, 69, 71A-71F) and 'Total Hours/Units 97'. A reviewer should check whether the A.S. Degree page uses the same requirements; the closed list closely matches these courses.
The certificate section prints eight Program Student Learning Outcomes; they were not recorded because they are printed under the certificate, not the A.S. Degree.

The certificate notes say the program prerequisites fulfill graduation requirements in areas A, B, C, D and G of the Option A General Education Pattern, implying an associate degree path, but no A.S. requirements are printed.
Retrieve the catalog page for the Radiologic Technology A.S. Degree (likely on an adjacent page, e.g. page 355) and re-extract.
